name: Auggie
source:
The part of Augustia's soul that wishes to overcome death and continue living no matter the cost, Auggie split off from her when she decided she wanted otherwise. He fights against Iris and is willing to go against the entire world in order to do what he thinks is best for Augustia. However, Iris might be the only one who can convince him to finally let go.

Despite his rough appearance, he's very neat and shows common courtesy unlike the Magician he shares a face with. He wears a collared shirt under his clothes and tends to tuck his shirt in.

A bit self-destructive but is good at taking care of others. He'll do anything to protect those close to him, or even just friends of friends.

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/12484533.auggie]official bio[/url]]
